title: NodesPost
description: NodesPost describes a request to create a new node on AMS

address.description: Internal IP address of the node

cpu_allocation_rate.description: CPU allocation rate for the node

cpus.description: Number of CPUs on the node

gpu_encoder_slots.description: Number of GPU encoder slots to configure on the node

gpu_slots.description: Number of GPU slots to configure on the node

memory_allocation_rate.description: Memory allocation rate for the node

network_acl_name.description: Name of the network ACL to create on the LXD node

network_bridge_mtu.description: MTU for the configured network bridge on LXD

network_name.description: Name of the network bridge to create on the LXD node

network_subnet.description: CIDR of the subnet to configure for the network bridge on LXD

public_address.description: Public IP address of the node

storage_device.description: Storage device to use for configuring LXD storage pools

storage_pool.description: Name of the storage pool to use for configuring the LXD node

tags.description: Tags to attach to the node

trust_password.description: Trust password for the LXD instance

unmanaged.description: Flag used to control if AMS can manage the LXD node
